title: Cold-start grounded instruction and causal planning in unfamiliar compositional worlds

parent.scope: WSP58 frozen SELFTEST signal PASS, Linux/Windows focused + G29 PASS, full regression still pending

research_question: Can a source-blind, zero-gradient, non-next-token causal learner infer transition rules in unfamiliar worlds from charged interactions, ground previously unseen byte-encoded task symbols from demonstrations, plan multi-step solutions, and preserve knowledge after cold restoration?
independence: All WSP59 seed worlds new. Separate evaluator-only generator; does not import previous WSP57/58 world functions or share their operator-table structure. Does not establish broad independent external distribution or AGI.

source.cohort: SELFTEST, eight preregistered seeds 2501-2508. DEV/PRIMARY forbidden.
source.states: 3 observable discrete physical registers: 5-position dial, binary gate and binary marker (20 joint states). Four unlabeled action channels, randomly permuted per world.
source.hidden_physics: Different non-affine 5-state dial permutations, gate-conditional dial transformation, marker-conditional dial transformation, dial-conditional binary gate toggle, dial-conditional binary marker toggle; per-world hidden shuffled channels and independent stochastic-looking but deterministic parameter seeds. Every next-state register depends on at most two current-state registers, with identities as special cases.
source.exposed_information: Each charged intervention returns only (current-state, chosen-action-channel, next-state); no function tables, variable causal parents, channel roles, withheld action transitions, source import, or task-plan oracle.
source.instructions: Nine nonce ASCII byte phrases, randomized per world, each demonstrated with its corresponding single grounded (register,value) predicate; heldout tasks contain novel two-predicate conjunctions in a fixed public ' & ' interface format, never shown as combined examples.
source.action_budget: 40 charged state-action probes per policy: 10 distinct states for each of 4 channels. Causal-coverage policy chooses pairwise-context-covering states before seeing outcomes; random policy chooses 10 distinct states per channel without replacement from same 20 possible states. Both receive identical demonstration budget of nine labeled phrases.
source.tasks: 32 per world; 256 total. At task generation choose starts and conjunctive predicate goals with an oracle-achievable shortest plan length 2-4 and nontrivial initial condition. No task outcome or required sequence used for learner selection; evaluator uses oracle exclusively to construct and score test goals.
source.task_scoring: The agent only observes heldout start state and composed instruction bytes, not parsed goal predicates or source simulator. It must independently infer goal semantics from demos, synthesize a plan of <=4 actions using its learned transition model, and return action channels. Score success by executing returned plan on original source world.
source.source_receipts: World/hypothesis/train ledgers hashed with SHA256, seeds, action count, prospective holdout task SHA256, deterministic platform invariance.

learner.architecture: General three-register, max-two-causal-parent truth-table constraint induction from charged observations: choose smallest fully covered consistent parent subset for each next-state register/action. Store learned numerical transition tables explicitly; no hidden source families or oracle action roles imported.
learner.active_policy: Pairwise-state-context coverage for all unknown causal-parent subsets, source-blind, precommit to state probes. This is structured experimental design, NOT feedback-adaptive curiosity.
learner.language_interface: Raw byte strings -> taught grounded predicate records; conjunction parsing is a given syntax contract, not natural language or open vocabulary understanding. Underlying causal state/plan representations are numerical; no autoregressive next-token training.
learner.planner: Breadth-first search over uniquely predictable learned transitions, maximum depth 4, shortest-first, deterministic tie-break; abstain when missing safe model steps.
learner.retention: Canonical SHA256 snapshot of all public observations and demonstration mappings; cold restore reconstructs numerical tables and yields identical predictions/plans; tamper must fail.

controls: Seed-hashed random 40-action policy with identical learner, same symbol demonstrations, same heldout goals, same breadth-first planner
Exact state-action memorization on active 40 interventions (no causal factorization), same instruction mapping/planner
Permutation/shuffle of grounded symbol demonstration semantics as a language grounding negative control (same 40 physical interventions).
metrics: Fraction of 256 heldout goals solved with physically valid plans (micro + each world) for all controls
Heldout transition prediction correct/wrong/abstain across each 80 state-action table; target 0 active wrong-confident
Unseen conjunction grounding exact mapping, plan length and correctness against oracle shortest path
Cold snapshot parity, SHA256, tampering, retained planning across cold restore
Action budget exactly 40, symbol demos exactly 9 per policy, source/seed independence
Per-world whole-process wall/CPU plus memory snapshot bits; planning search expansions and stored numeric table size
frozen_primary_success: Exploratory SELFTEST_SIGNAL only if causal coverage agent solves >=65% of 256 heldout tasks, beats equally probed random agent by >=15 percentage points on exactly the same tasks, makes ZERO incorrect confident transition predictions across all 8 x 80 physical transitions, achieves 100% exact taught predicate decoding and cold restore parity in all 8 worlds. Otherwise record SELFTEST_NEGATIVE_OR_INCONCLUSIVE; no retrospective tuning.
structural_controls: Exact-memory and language-shuffle negative controls are reported as diagnostic, not required to fail a threshold to rescue a missed primary criterion.
limitations: Factored max-two-parent prior is aligned with evaluator's generated world family, therefore learned transitions do not establish unconstrained new causal law discovery
All nine primitive predicate meanings are explicitly demonstrated; novel instruction generalization is fixed-conjunction composition, NOT general natural-language comprehension
Tasks generated to be reachable within 2-4 steps; this is a structured finite planning benchmark, not unbounded autonomy
No fully trained conventional neural agent or independently implemented equal-compute symbolic control; action matched does not imply compute matched.
No WSP59 DEV/PRIMARY scientific first-use, unrelated model deployment, integration or scientific superiority conclusion
stop_rules: Predeclared 8 seeds, thresholds, 40 probe actions, 9 demos, 32 tasks, structural prior and metric frozen before model/source code and outcomes.
Do not modify frozen WSP58 experiment or thresholds.
Any source/schema implementation bug is documented and fixed without outcome-dependent policy/tuning; if outcome-guided changes needed a new prereg experiment is required.
Full inherited Linux/Windows regression, focused controls and G29 exact-source atlas before engineering closure.
